entries.subject: Selected source model
entries.finding: Checked 2026-09-09. Original [DAMIT model 1862](https://damit.cuni.cz/projects/damit/asteroid_models/view/1862), version 2017-11-21. Convex lightcurve model at a thermophysical diameter of 3.5 km; the published interval is 3.1–3.8 km. Model fields and mesh measurements.

entries.subject: Registered surface imagery
entries.finding: Reference-period display rotation does not propagate the published YORP effect. - No registered reflectance texture is available. Grid marks missing imagery; Elevation is shape-derived radius relative to a sphere, not measured geology.
entries.revisitWhen: A released, reusable surface observation or mapped product with registration to this body’s selected source model; the existing grid alone does not imply that every archive was searched.
